Rby sir best for learning.
Sir onek valo kore bujhay prottekta topics. So, kono problem hobe na bujhte. Math sundar kre board e lekhe bujhiye dibe. Sir onek strict rules and regulations er bepare. Like, apnk calculator, book regular niye jaite hobe. And apni nichen kina seta uni regular check korbe. Na pele mind korbe. Ar, eta shavabik o. Apni Fin class e calculator chara ar boi chara kichu e bujhben na. Tai calculator na paile sedin ar class korte dibe na apnk. Class e onr rules 100% follow korte hobe. Tahole sir bhalo. Rules break korle pochani sure.
Sir jokhon porabe, obossoi class e perform korben. Sir eta onek like kore.
Class e je math gula koray ogulai halka kichu change kore exam e dey. Tai regular class korle pera nai. Exam e parben. But vuleo cheat korte jaben na. Sir exam time onek strict thake.
Grading jeta expected setai paben. Curve depands on total class performance. Jodi class performance valo thake sobar, tahole to curve laghbe na. class performance sobar kharap thakle sir sobaike curve korbe. Kintu dhoren class er 10 jon er performance extraordinary, but baki der performance khub kharap, sekhetre kono curve korbe na sir. Sir, curve korle sobaike korbe, na korle kauke korbe na.
But ami suggest korbo, sir er kache course ta kore dekhte paren. I think valoi laghbe.
